headline: Sygnum Bank — AI agent plans and prepares multi-step on-chain transactions
task: independently planned and prepared each step, reviewed the relevant smart contracts, and flagged potential transaction risks
technique: in-house MCP server using Anthropic's Claude
evidence: The Sygnum AI agent used these instructions and independently planned and prepared each step, reviewed the relevant smart contracts, and flagged potential transaction risks before presenting each transaction to the client for approval.
notes: Pilot, not production, on the article's own word: 'The pilot was built using a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server built in-house by the AI@Sygnum team.' Reached the corpus through seed-urls rather than any feed.

headline: Sygnum Bank — plain-text commands orchestrate on-chain operations
task: interprets plain-text commands to orchestrate complex, multi-step operations directly on blockchain mainnets
technique: in-house MCP server built around Anthropic's Claude
evidence: Users issue simple plain-text commands, which the AI agent interprets to orchestrate complex, multi-step operations directly on blockchain mainnets. These can include stablecoin transfers, asset exchanges, on-chain lending adjustments, token wrapping, and liquidity management.
notes: Second report. The caveat the stage rests on is in this article: 'While the MCP AI agent is not yet available for general client use.'
